source.snippet: I'm trying to ship a Data Cloud Data Model Object (a CustomObject with mktDataModelAttributes, i.e. an object ending in __dlm) plus its fields and a DataPackageKitDefinition / DataPackageKitObject (a Data Kit) inside a second-generation Salesforce package, so it can be installed the same way as any other custom object. Building a regular unlocked package fails at sf package version create time.

problem_statement: Salesforce ISV developers cannot package Data Cloud DMO custom objects into second-generation (2GP) unlocked packages, blocking them from distributing Data Cloud-native solutions to customers through standard AppExchange mechanisms.
target_segment: Salesforce ISVs and consulting partners building Data Cloud-native products or accelerators who need to distribute packaged solutions via AppExchange.
notes: Clear ISV context — these are businesses building products on Salesforce for resale, i.e. confirmed paying buyers. Packaging failures are a known category of pain in the Salesforce ISV ecosystem and often drive consulting spend. Single data point here keeps signal at 2, but the specificity of the technical blocker (DMO + 2GP) suggests it will affect every ISV entering the Data Cloud space as it grows. Potential angle: consulting service, automated packaging tooling, or documentation/template product.
